sources.entry: Rust: _0dmg: Learning Rust by building a partial Game Boy emulator_

summary.title: 0dmg
summary.one_liner: A devlog and resource list for learning Rust by building a partial Game Boy (DMG) emulator.
takeaways: The project is a daily devlog (May to July 2018) of building a partial Game Boy emulator in Rust.
A curated list of Game Boy dev references: CPU manual, bootstrap ROM, memory map, opcode tables, and Pandocs.
Pointers to related emulator write-ups and discussions, including a Game Boy emulator blog post and Hacker News threads.
Rust learning resources linked alongside the project: The Rust Book, VS Code Rust tooling, and the Rust-WASM book.
summary.summary: This is a personal project page by jeremyBanks that documents learning Rust by writing a partial Game Boy emulator. The main content is a dated list of log entries from May to July 2018, mostly titled "Update", plus a set of linked references. The references cover Game Boy hardware and CPU docs (CPU manual, bootstrap ROM, memory layout, opcode tables, Pandocs, cartridge header, sound operation) and some Z80 instruction set resources. The page itself does not show code or a step-by-step tutorial, so the entries are only titles in the text provided.
